notes.title: The project is alive – and Early Access is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s been a while since our last update, and we just wanted to take a moment to say : Development is coming along great! Since our last update, we’ve doubled down, and the game is now reaching a level we feel is just about ready for Early Access.

We’ve made a lot of progress over the past few months. The game has grown, improved, and evolved into something we’re truly proud of. Our blacksmiths are working hard behind the scenes — hammer in one hand, coffee in the other—to get everything ready for release! The team’s more motivated than ever and we can’t wait to show you what we’ve been working on.

We want to thank everyone who’s been following the project, sharing feedback, and showing support. It means a lot to us. We’ll be back soon with more details, but until then, know that things are moving forward—and we can’t wait to show you what’s coming.

Thanks so much for your patience and support. Stay tuned—we’ll be announcing a launch date soon!

notes.title: We exist!
notes.content:
Welcome, everyone!

We are thrilled to introduce ourselves as a brand-new video game company, and we’re even more excited to present our very first project: Adventurer Shop Simulator! This is just the beginning of what we hope will be many amazing games to come.

Adventurer Shop Simulator is a casual and relaxing game where you step into the role of a shopkeeper, selling equipment to NPCs eager to embark on adventures. You’ll start with a limited selection of items, but as you progress, you can unlock more through a skill tree featuring three unique classes: Warrior, Ranger, and Mage. You can choose to specialize in one class, or diversify by exploring two or even all three!

The game is currently in Early Access, offering a foundational experience with plenty more planned for the future. We’ll be sharing a roadmap soon, so stay tuned!

Your support and feedback are incredibly important to us. If you have ideas to improve the game, notice something that feels off, or encounter a bug, please don’t hesitate to leave a comment or join us on Discord to share your thoughts. While we can’t promise to implement every suggestion, we promise to carefully read all your messages and take them into consideration.

Thank you so much for your support—we hope you enjoy your time with Adventurer Shop Simulator!
